---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an improvement to Settleview
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**What problem would this solve?**
Describe the situation, for example "On the phone I can't tell ... before I slide to buy".

**What you'd like**
The change you have in mind.

**Alternatives you considered**

**Is this a trading idea?**
If the request rests on a rule that is supposed to beat the market, please check
[`docs/research/LEARNINGS.md`](../../docs/research/LEARNINGS.md) first. Many popular rules have already been tested
and failed after fees. New ideas need a pre-registered test (see the honesty rules in `AGENTS.md`) before they go into
the app.

**Checks**
- [ ] It doesn't need fake or sample data in the app.
- [ ] It doesn't weaken human approval, the kill switch, limits or other trading guards.
